name: FranceTV Sport VR
summary:
# France Télévisions offers you the chance to experience unique sports events through this application!

Teleport yourself to the heart of the biggest sports events covered by France Télévisions with a 360° and 3D view!
From locations usually inaccessible to the general public, experience or relive the highlights of these events alongside the France Télévisions presenters as if you were there!

Because the immersion doesn't stop there, enjoy exclusive immersive reports that decode the specifics of each disc
